info.name: Real Estate API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Real Estate Mobile API.

**Setup:**
1. Import this collection into Postman.
2. The `baseUrl` variable defaults to `http://localhost:8080` — change it for staging/prod.
3. Call **Login** first; the test script automatically saves the JWT to `{{token}}`.
4. All protected endpoints inherit the Bearer token from the collection-level auth.

**Variables:** `baseUrl`, `token`, `userId`, `propertyId`, `bankId`, `leadId`, `documentId`, `projectId`, `providerId`, `relationId`

item.name: 🔐 Auth
